input_zh: 固定权威 Analysis 控制源为 main 提交 86eca18d97eea15bf327792cff94fe523c705708，其中包含 Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Analysis Prompt v2.0.0 与全部 7 个 requiredSources；Generated Analysis Prompt 的确定性 SHA-256 核验与声明值 4f40dff2d12569f647bf265f344b60cb0f0cd0349f0b2d5cf1023f50947dfea2 完全一致；同日唯一已核验 Analysis Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-06/analysis-125756.json；受治理的 Reconciliation 于 13:02:50+08:00 持久打开 Analysis Execution Slot，13:04:38+08:00 在提交 7b1f1202c037821e1520cf519befe10c7d52db81 中持久记录 Worker Claimed；业务输入严格只来自同日 Completed Reading Result 及三份 Source-complete Reading Note Q-20260906-01、Q-20260906-02 与 Q-20260906-03。
workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the three same-date completed Reading Notes and produced three bounded Research Objects. Q-20260906-01 concludes that failure-risk admission, protocol-specific collaboration value and budget admission require separate evidence identities: a strong failure detector does not establish the best collaboration topology, and a topology recommendation does not itself authorize its resource cost. Q-20260906-02 concludes that resilience evidence must be phase-indexed: degradation, containment, restoration and cumulative burden remain distinct even after a recovered terminal state; autonomous agent proposals also remain distinct from authoritative environment mutation. Q-20260906-03 concludes that stable principal identity, state continuity, destination compatibility and execution authority are separate recovery gates: correct logical identity enables deterministic restoration but does not grant a destination or present execution authority. All three objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, cover generation, Production staging or Publication was performed.
workResult_zh: Skill 04 仅消费三份同日 Completed Reading Note，并生成三份有界 Research Object。Q-20260906-01 的结论是 Failure-risk Admission、Protocol-specific Collaboration Value 与 Budget Admission 需要独立的 Evidence Identity：强 Failure Detector 不能证明哪种 Collaboration Topology 最合适，而 Protocol Recommendation 本身也不授权其资源成本。Q-20260906-02 的结论是 Resilience Evidence 必须按阶段保存：Degradation、Containment、Restoration 与 Cumulative Burden 即使在最终 Recovered 后仍是不同事实；Autonomous Agent Proposal 也不能等同于 Authoritative Environment Mutation。Q-20260906-03 的结论是 Stable Principal Identity、State Continuity、Destination Compatibility 与 Execution Authority 是不同 Recovery Gate：正确的 Logical Identity 可以支持确定性恢复，但不会自动授予 Destination 或当前 Execution Authority。三份对象均为 ReadyForProduction、production_input_authorized=true、publication_authorized=false。未执行文章写作、题图生成、Production Staging 或 Publication。
